SELECT m.source_type, m.source_record_key, m.product_id, category.category_id, m.sku_id, m.sales_point_id, m.warehouse_id, m.lot_id, m.inventory_balance_id, m.sku_channel_price_id, m.sku_cost_id, m.inventory_policy_id, src.product_name, src.brand_name, src.product_status, src.sale_available_yn, src.sku_name, src.net_weight, src.weight_unit, src.package_quantity, src.unit_code, src.storage_type, src.selling_price, src.actual_price, src.product_cost, src.payment_fee, src.logistics_cost, src.price_effective_from, src.price_effective_to, src.sku_unit_cost, src.manufactured_date, src.received_date, src.expiry_date, src.sale_stop_date, src.lot_status, src.safety_stock_qty, src.target_stock_qty, src.on_hand_qty, src.reserved_qty, src.record_hash, st.current_version AS source_version, src.row_version FROM inventory_source_row_map m JOIN inventory_source_state st ON st.source_type = m.source_type JOIN (
SELECT source_record_key, 'OFFLINE' AS source_type, COALESCE(category_small_name, category_middle_name, category_large_name) AS category_name, item_name AS product_name, brand_label AS brand_name, merchandise_state_code AS product_status, sale_flag AS sale_available_yn, branch_option_name AS sku_name, content_value AS net_weight, content_unit_label AS weight_unit, sell_pack_count AS package_quantity, sell_unit_label AS unit_code, storage_method_text AS storage_type, tag_price_amount AS selling_price, store_sale_price_amount AS actual_price, store_unit_cost_amount AS product_cost, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS payment_fee, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS logistics_cost, price_valid_from AS price_effective_from, price_valid_to AS price_effective_to, store_unit_cost_amount AS sku_unit_cost, TO_DATE(made_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS manufactured_date, TO_DATE(received_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS received_date, TO_DATE(use_by_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expiry_date, TO_DATE(sale_stop_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sale_stop_date, store_lot_state_code AS lot_status, safe_stock_count AS safety_stock_qty, target_stock_count AS target_stock_qty, available_stock_count AS on_hand_qty, reserved_stock_count AS reserved_qty, record_hash, synced_record_hash, row_version FROM inventory_source_offline WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT source_record_key, 'ECOMMERCE' AS source_type, TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(display_category_path, '[^>]+$')) AS category_name, display_product_title AS product_name, seller_brand_label AS brand_name, catalog_state_code AS product_status, option_enabled_flag AS sale_available_yn, seller_option_name AS sku_name, content_amount AS net_weight, content_uom_label AS weight_unit, order_pack_count AS package_quantity, order_unit_label AS unit_code, delivery_temperature_code AS storage_type, display_list_price AS selling_price, discounted_sale_price AS actual_price, seller_unit_cost_amount AS product_cost, payment_fee_amount AS payment_fee, delivery_cost_amount AS logistics_cost, price_started_on AS price_effective_from, price_ended_on AS price_effective_to, seller_unit_cost_amount AS sku_unit_cost, TO_DATE(made_on_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS manufactured_date, TO_DATE(stocked_on_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS received_date, TO_DATE(expires_on_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expiry_date, TO_DATE(blocked_on_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sale_stop_date, batch_state_code AS lot_status, safety_quantity AS safety_stock_qty, target_quantity AS target_stock_qty, sellable_quantity AS on_hand_qty, ordered_quantity AS reserved_qty, record_hash, synced_record_hash, row_version FROM inventory_source_ecommerce WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT source_record_key, 'GREETING' AS source_type, COALESCE(menu_group_small, menu_group_middle, menu_group_large) AS category_name, menu_name AS product_name, COALESCE(brand_display_name, maker_name) AS brand_name, menu_sale_state AS product_status, CASE sold_out_flag WHEN 'Y' THEN 'N' WHEN 'N' THEN 'Y' END AS sale_available_yn, greeting_sku_name AS sku_name, net_content_amount AS net_weight, net_content_unit_label AS weight_unit, package_count AS package_quantity, sale_unit_label AS unit_code, cold_chain_type AS storage_type, normal_price_amount AS selling_price, member_price_amount AS actual_price, menu_unit_cost_amount AS product_cost, payment_fee_amount AS payment_fee, shipping_cost_amount AS logistics_cost, membership_price_from AS price_effective_from, membership_price_to AS price_effective_to, menu_unit_cost_amount AS sku_unit_cost, TO_DATE(cooked_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS manufactured_date, TO_DATE(received_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS received_date, TO_DATE(consume_by_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expiry_date, TO_DATE(sale_block_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sale_stop_date, production_batch_state AS lot_status, minimum_stock_count AS safety_stock_qty, target_stock_count AS target_stock_qty, saleable_meal_count AS on_hand_qty, committed_meal_count AS reserved_qty, record_hash, synced_record_hash, row_version FROM inventory_source_greeting WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT source_record_key, 'WAREHOUSE' AS source_type, TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(goods_category_name, '[^>]+$')) AS category_name, center_product_name AS product_name, goods_brand_name AS brand_name, goods_state_code AS product_status, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS sale_available_yn, center_sku_name AS sku_name, stock_net_weight AS net_weight, stock_weight_unit AS weight_unit, units_per_case AS package_quantity, stock_unit_code AS unit_code, temperature_zone_code AS storage_type, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS selling_price, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS actual_price, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS product_cost, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS payment_fee, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS logistics_cost, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS price_effective_from, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS price_effective_to, standard_unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost, TO_DATE(manufactured_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS manufactured_date, TO_DATE(inbound_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS received_date, TO_DATE(expiry_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expiry_date, TO_DATE(shipping_stop_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sale_stop_date, lot_quality_state AS lot_status, center_safety_qty AS safety_stock_qty, center_target_qty AS target_stock_qty, physical_available_qty AS on_hand_qty, physical_reserved_qty AS reserved_qty, record_hash, synced_record_hash, row_version FROM inventory_source_warehouse WHERE active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(300)) AS source_record_key, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS source_type, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS category_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(300)) AS product_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(150)) AS brand_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS product_status, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS sale_available_yn, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(300)) AS sku_name, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,3)) AS net_weight, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS weight_unit, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,3)) AS package_quantity, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS unit_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS storage_type, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS selling_price, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS actual_price, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS product_cost, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS payment_fee, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS logistics_cost, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS price_effective_from, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS price_effective_to, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS sku_unit_cost, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS manufactured_date, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS received_date, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS expiry_date, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS sale_stop_date, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS lot_status, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,3)) AS safety_stock_qty, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,3)) AS target_stock_qty, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,3)) AS on_hand_qty, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,3)) AS reserved_qty, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(64)) AS record_hash, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(64)) AS synced_record_hash, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(19)) AS row_version FROM dual WHERE 1 = 0
) src ON src.source_type = m.source_type AND src.source_record_key = m.source_record_key LEFT JOIN category category ON category.category_name = src.category_name AND category.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.source_type = #{sourceType} AND m.mapping_status = 'MAPPED' AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND st.current_version = #{sourceVersion} AND (src.synced_record_hash IS NULL OR src.record_hash != src.synced_record_hash)
AND m.source_record_key > #{lastSourceRecordKey}
ORDER BY m.source_record_key FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
